tests.name: Coulomb counting
tests.detail: 5 A, 5 Ah, 360 s; analytical SOC = 0.9.

tests.name: 2-RC exact integration
tests.detail: Both frozen-coefficient RC branches versus their exponential closed forms.

tests.name: OCV entropic derivative
tests.detail: The temperature-dependent OCV law and the specified I*T*dU/dT coefficient use the same derivative.

tests.name: Discharge heat sign
tests.detail: Signed I(Vterm-Uocv) is negative; generated heat uses the opposite sign.

tests.name: Stiff-source boundedness
tests.detail: 2000 K, dt = 1e6 s; all four Patankar reaction states remain in [0,1].

tests.name: Reaction-energy closure
tests.detail: Coupled implicit temperature and reaction extent conserve released chemical energy.

tests.name: FVM thermal conservation
tests.detail: Closed two-cell system: internal diffusive heat cancels exactly.

tests.name: Curle stationary limit
tests.detail: Farassat 1A reduces to the stationary loading dipole, including its near-field term.

tests.name: Subsonic Doppler term
tests.detail: Isolated Qdot term at Mr=0.3 scales with (1-Mr)^-2.

tests.name: Retarded-time recovery
tests.detail: Monotone arrival-time bisection recovers a known source time.

tests.name: One-sided Hann PSD
tests.detail: Unit-RMS, 128 Hz signal; window-power normalized PSD integrates to 1 Pa2.

tests.name: OASPL pressure reference
tests.detail: 1 Pa RMS / 20 microPa = 93.9794000867 dB.

tests.name: Hartmann Ha 1-100
tests.detail: Five Hartmann numbers; 1024 intervals; RMS normalized velocity error.

tests.name: Hartmann grid convergence
tests.detail: Second-order channel operator; coarse/fine error ratio approaches four.

tests.name: Polyhedral current moment
tests.detail: Affine-skewed 3D cells: sum Jn,f (xf-xP) / V exactly reconstructs a constant current.

tests.name: Non-orthogonal potential
tests.detail: Over-relaxed alpha and deferred correction reproduce a manufactured linear potential.

tests.name: Discrete charge conservation
tests.detail: The reconstructed face flux uses the same stencil as the elliptic potential solve.

tests.name: Insulating motional cancellation
tests.detail: Full SoA electric projection cancels a uniform motional EMF with grad(phi).

tests.name: Lorentz-Joule work identity
tests.detail: Full face-flux reconstruction and source assembly: u dot (J cross B) + |J|2/sigma = 0 for grad(phi)=0.

tests.name: Incompressible flux projection
tests.detail: Skewed collocated 3D grid; projected velocity face flux is divergence free.

tests.name: Joule heat-energy coupling
tests.detail: Electric-potential driven conduction: the common implicit FVM energy equation receives exactly J2/sigma times cell volume.

tests.name: Pyrolysis positivity
tests.detail: Stiff virgin-to-char Patankar step respects rho_char and the initial density.

tests.name: Pyrolysis mass-enthalpy
tests.detail: Released gas mass times formation enthalpy equals the solid-energy sink.

tests.name: Multi-stage pyrolysis mass
tests.detail: Two nonlinear Arrhenius constituents plus inert mass; stage gas sources sum to bulk mass loss.

tests.name: 3D porous-gas blowing
tests.detail: Quasi-steady Darcy projection on a skewed 3D mesh: boundary gas outflow equals integrated pyrolysis generation.

tests.name: Gas enthalpy conservation
tests.detail: Upwind internal gas-energy fluxes cancel pairwise; net cell outflow equals boundary enthalpy flux.

tests.name: 3D porous thermal coupling
tests.detail: Full SoA source, Darcy blowing, gas enthalpy transport, and polyhedral implicit solid-energy step.

tests.name: TPS surface energy balance
tests.detail: Incident heating = conduction + reradiation + gas enthalpy + sublimation.

tests.name: BDF2 discrete GCL
tests.detail: Signed swept-face BDF2 flux equals the BDF2 cell-volume derivative.

tests.name: ALE free-stream preservation
tests.detail: Uniform field remains uniform on a receding 1D mesh satisfying DGCL.

tests.name: Polyhedral DGCL projection
tests.detail: Perturbed internal mesh fluxes on a skewed 3D topology are corrected to the BDF2 volume derivative.

tests.name: BDF2 nodal recession
tests.detail: SoA 3D boundary-node motion reproduces an affine material-normal recession exactly.

tests.name: Exact 3D swept-volume DGCL
tests.detail: Triangle-sweep quadrature on a deforming tetrahedron: face-flux sum equals BDF2 volume change without a correction solve.

tests.name: ALE geometry-current consistency
tests.detail: Updated polyhedral centroids, volumes, area vectors, alpha and correction preserve the constant-current moment identity.

tests.name: ALE TPS coupled smoke test
tests.detail: One second of pyrolysis, blowing, nonlinear wall balance, conduction, and recession.
